focus: Target-lux solve bounds, zero and unavailable photometry, rejection preserving output, valid UI commits

checks.result: Finite nonnegative target, valid source and validated scene are required. Positive solve uses a one-candela sample and explicitly rejects nil, zero or nonfinite unit lux.

The forward-model output at 100,000 cd bounds the target before division. nextUp(maximumLux) is rejected; inverse-rounding overflow can use the validated maximum only after the achieved/target relative accuracy check <= 1e-9.
An explicit zero sets only candela to zero before any photometric sample, including valid scenes with unavailable photometric geometry. Invalid scenes and invalid source settings still reject.

StudioLight and LightingScene are value types; the function returns a local copy and cannot mutate the supplied source or scene on rejection. Identity, geometry and all non-candela values are preserved on success.

Target parsing is bounded, localized and finite/nonnegative. Invalid text disables Apply. Oversized replacement preserves the previous draft and blocks Apply until a changed acceptable draft. Solver rejection only records an error; onApply is invoked only after successful solve.
didApply is set before the callback, preventing queued or reentrant duplicate applies during dismissal. Unavailable/noneditable current lux does not seed a rounded zero.

Reviewed all eight test methods: rounded inverse maximum, nextDown maximum, nextUp and 1.01x maximum across all emitter kinds/width fixtures, unchanged exact maximum, off-to-maximum, zero with unavailable geometry, subnormal integration underflow, and ordinary interior target accuracy. Assertions cover preservation of original scene/source and unchanged identity/geometry in the main maximum case.

limitations: Static source/test review only. Host unavailable; no scripts, Swift tests, builds, simulator/UI workflows or runtime experiments executed.
Scoped review does not establish full M02/M03 acceptance, physical calibration or release readiness.
Current-branch/worktree state and runtime results were not inspected; all successful source reads pinned to base_sha.
